greeting: Up, up, and away! That's my motto. And my business model!
Welcome to the skies! Need a lift? I've got balloons!
Cirrus Cloudsworth, at your service! Balloons for every occasion!
Feeling grounded? I can fix that!
The sky isn't the limit - it's just the beginning!
Blue balloons, blue skies! It's a theme! I have themes!
Ever wanted to touch a cloud? I can get you close!
dialog.shop_open: Balloons of all sizes! Weather-resistant! Mostly crash-proof! Satisfaction guaranteed or your altitude back!
dialog.shop_prompt: Looking to ascend? I've got single-riders, double-deckers, and the deluxe cloud-cruiser!
haggle: These prices are already sky-high! Get it? ...I'll do ten percent off.
For a fellow dreamer? Special discount!
Balloons aren't cheap to fill! But... okay, five percent.
You drive a hard bargain! I respect that in a customer!
purchase_success: Excellent choice! She's a real floater!
Remember: don't pop it! That's bad!
Careful in high winds! Actually, avoid all winds!
Your ticket to the clouds! Literally!
purchase_fail: No coin, no climb! Harsh but true!
Balloons cost money! Helium costs money!
Come back when you've saved up! The sky can wait!
rumor: They say the sunandmoon can predict storms a week early. Useful for ballooning!
Red's balloons are cheaper, but mine are SAFER. Probably.
The sky-train conductor claims to have seen the edge of the world. Doubtful!
Something weird happening at the Remnant Vault. Balloons won't fly over it!
The twins gave me a fortune: 'Beware of sharp objects.' Very helpful!
dialog.quest_hook: I need quality canvas from the ground-dwellers! My supplier dried up. Bring me three bolts of Cloud-Silk Canvas and I'll make it worth your while!
dialog.quest_active: Find that Cloud-Silk Canvas yet? My business is deflating here!
dialog.quest_complete: THE CANVAS! Beautiful! I can make the BIGGEST balloon now! Here - take this Cloud-Hopper. Custom made!
dialog.quest_reward: Cloud-Hopper Deluxe - Superior altitude and comfort!
farewell: Safe flights! Mind the wind shear!
Come back anytime! The sky is always open!
ambient_barks: Blue is the color of the SKY!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning ascensions are the prettiest! The sunrise from 500 feet!
dialog.time_noon: Thermal currents are strong today! Watch your drift!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening flights! The sunset balloons are romantic!
dialog.time_night: Night flying? Not recommended! But possible! For a price!

party_reactions.kade: Balloons. You're serious about the balloons.
party_reactions.nix7: Helium or hydrogen? Please say helium.
party_reactions.twist: I want to go HIGHER! Can we go higher?!
party_reactions.korr: A noble pursuit. The sky calls to all dreamers.
party_reactions.renna: The physics of this seem... questionable.
party_reactions.suresh: To float above the earth is to see the world anew.
party_reactions.sova: I'd rather keep my feet on the ground, thanks.
party_reactions.grit: Hydrogen balloons. In a lightning zone. Genius.
party_reactions.ashka: Can you make FIRE balloons? That would be AMAZING!
party_reactions.senna: Ever drop anything valuable? From way up high?
party_reactions.petra: Solid ground. That's all I need.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time buying altitude? I explain everything!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more sky? I knew you had good taste!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite customer! I've got a special balloon just for you!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! My business partner in dreaming! Let's go UP together!

mini_quest.title: The Canvas Run
mini_quest.description: Bring Cloud-Silk Canvas to Cirrus for his balloon business

stages.hook: I need Cloud-Silk Canvas! Three bolts! My balloon business depends on it!
stages.active: The weavers in Tide have the best canvas. Or try the Dustbelt traders!
stages.complete: PERFECT! With this, I can craft something truly special! Here - my finest work!
